spatial_resolution.note: 1 arc-second grid matching USGS SRTM 1 Arc-Second global DEM

UTM_Zone_46N.coverage: Central/Eastern Meghalaya & all of Mizoram (12 MGRS tiles)

scientific_rationale: The 1-arc-second (~30 m) SRTM-aligned grid serves as the continuous regional modeling backbone covering 100% of Phase 1 AOI (Meghalaya & Mizoram) without projection boundary distortions or seam-line discontinuities between UTM Zone 45N and 46N. Native Sentinel-2 10m indices, GPM ~10km rainfall, and SMAP ~9km soil moisture remain strictly preserved in their original resolutions, with aligned representations generated specifically for multi-factor model integration.
